insurer_name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 24 months. Hypertension/diabetes/cardiac 90-day waiting if undisclosed. Worldwide cover has 2-year waiting from opt-in.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Annual Sum Insured plus GCB plus Super NCB plus SI Protector

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care procedures (less than 24 hours under GA/LA)

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for in-patient AYUSH
ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Maternity expenses including caesarean delivery and lawful termination — optional cover with specified waiting period

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Medical Expenses of new born baby up to 90 days from birth, when Maternity Cover is applicable
newborn_coverage.notes: Available only if Maternity Cover opted

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor expenses covered up to specified limit

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance and Air ambulance available; emergency ambulance services

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Optional Critical Illness add-on; lump-sum payout

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Unlimited Reset Benefit add-on; SI refilled unlimited times in a policy year

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Wellness Program / Preventive Health Check-up included; not subject to voluntary co-pay

copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-pay optional for premium discount; mandatory 10% co-pay on Worldwide Cover claims

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Worldwide Cover (optional) — hospitalisation including USA & Canada, up to Annual SI; 2-year waiting, 10% co-pay, 45 days/trip and 90 days cumulative per year
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Optional add-on; entry age cap 65; insured must be Indian resident

permanent_exclusions: Dental treatment unless due to accident
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI exclusions plus 24-month PED, 30-day initial, and 90-day undisclosed chronic-condition waits. Optional Worldwide Cover (USA & Canada included) has 2-year waiting, 10% co-pay, 45-day per-trip cap. Maternity, Newborn, and Critical Illness require add-on opt-in.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via 6500+ network hospitals; toll-free 1800 2666; CSE-assisted ambulance dispatch and tele-consultation.
